subject: microbiology
title: Immunoglobulins II: IgD, Secretory Component, J Chain and Fab/Fc Fragments

steps.tx: **IgD** is the naive B cell's second receptor (co expressed with IgM by alternative splicing), trace in serum, with emerging roles in mucosal immunity and basophil arming still being written. Its examination value is receptor identity, not serum function: a mature naive B cell wears IgM and IgD over the same variable region, ready for its first antigen.
steps.say: IgD is a receptor badge of naive B cells, not a serum worker.

left.title: IgD profile
points: Co expressed with IgM on naive B cells
No placental transfer or complement role

right.title: IgD frontiers
points: Hyper IgD in periodic fever syndromes (mevalonate)
Lost as B cells class switch

steps.tx: The **J chain** is the small joining polypeptide that polymerises IgM (pentamer) and IgA (dimer) and binds both to the polymeric immunoglobulin receptor for epithelial secretion. One peptide therefore explains two structures and a transport route, an economy examiners enjoy testing as a single fact with three addresses.
steps.say: J chain builds polymers and books their epithelial transport ticket.

left.title: J chain structures
points: Absent from IgG, IgE, IgD monomers

steps.tx: **Secretory component** is the cleaved extracellular piece of that polymeric receptor, wrapped around dimeric IgA in secretions as protease armour and mucus anchor. Its presence defines secretory IgA wherever found (milk, tears, gut), distinguishing secretion delivered antibody from serum leaked antibody in specimen interpretation.
steps.say: Secretory component is the transporter's gift wrapping; it proves IgA was delivered, not leaked.

left.title: Component facts
points: Covalently and noncovalently bound to IgA dimer
Free component in milk without IgA exists

right.title: Specimen meaning
points: Secretory IgA in saliva and stool

steps.tx: **Fab and Fc fragments** are papain's dissection: protease above the hinge yields two antigen binding Fab (variable plus CH1 and light chain) and one crystallisable Fc (class effectors), while pepsin below the hinge keeps F(ab)2 divalent and digests Fc away (antitoxins use this to shed Fc reactions). Fragment vocabulary governs modern antibody engineering formats.
steps.say: Papain cuts two arms and a stem; pepsin keeps arms joined and eats the stem.

left.title: Papain products
points: Fc fixes complement and Fc receptors

right.title: Pepsin products
points: Equine antitoxins use F(ab)2 to cut reactions

steps.tx: **Digoxin immune Fab** turns fragment logic into an antidote from the pharmacology lessons: sheep Fab binds free digoxin intravascularly, complexes clear renally, potassium normalises as pumps reactivate, dosed by ingested load or levels, with total digoxin assays lying afterward (bound measured as total). Fragment size avoiding Fc reduces allergy against a life saving deadline.
steps.say: Fab soaks digoxin off its pumps; after Fab, the digoxin level lies politely.

left.title: Fab antidote logic
points: Ovine Fab, Fc removed for tolerance
Dose by load, level or vials empirically

steps.tx: **Light chain biology** (kappa in about two thirds, lambda one third of human antibodies) becomes disease in plasma cell disorders: free light chains (Bence Jones proteins) filter into urine, cast nephropathy injures kidneys, amyloid AL deposits systemically, and the serum free light chain ratio flags clones before intact paraproteins declare myeloma.
steps.say: Free light chains in urine were oncology's first tumour marker; ratio assays refined the clue.

left.title: Light chain facts
points: Kappa lambda ratio about 2 to 1 normally
One B cell, one light chain type (allelic exclusion)
Bence Jones: urine free light chains

right.title: Light chain diseases
points: Heavy chain diseases by class (gamma, alpha, mu)

steps.tx: **Paraprotein workup** applies class anatomy to a spike: immunofixation names the heavy and light chain, quantitation tracks burden, IgM spikes hyperviscous (Waldenstrom), IgG and IgA spikes lyse bone (myeloma), and suppression of uninvolved immunoglobulins (immunoparesis) marks clonal dominance over the normal repertoire.
steps.say: Name the spike's class and light chain; the disease shortlist rearranges itself.

nodes.label: Immunofixation types heavy and light chain
Free light chain ratio and marrow assessed
Myeloma, Waldenstrom or MGUS pathway assigned

steps.tx: **Antibody engineering formats** descend from fragments: full monoclonals, Fab and single chain variable fragments (scFv joining heavy and light variable domains, CAR T receptors' binding heads), bispecifics riveting two antigens, and Fc engineering tuning half life and effector silence. Each format is Fab and Fc grammar recombined deliberately.
steps.say: scFv, bispecific, Fc silent: modern formats are fragment grammar recombined.

left.title: Fragment formats
points: scFv in CAR constructs and bispecifics

right.title: Fc engineering
points: Half life extension via FcRn affinity
Bispecific T cell engagers (CD3 times tumour)
